_comment: This is the SCHEMA/example, not live data. The real dependency-graph.json is written and owned exclusively by the Tech Lead (handoff-protocol.md §2). This is the ONLY place task dependencies are recorded — issue files reference an ID and nothing else, to avoid the drift that comes from storing the same relationship twice.
_validation_rule: Before execution and after every write, run a topological sort. A cycle halts the Tech Lead and raises status: blocked — do not attempt to auto-break the cycle.
